When enabled, both language selectors can be Automatic. Simple mode chooses the other language of the pair; advanced mode uses the first matching rule.

Local comparison: 58 words and 92 phrases/sentences. Turkish/English: 130 samples; the other five languages: 20. Times are medians after initialization; sizes are the code and model files used in the comparison. Lingua, MediaPipe, fastText, TinyLD and franc were restricted to seven languages; CLD2 and CLD3 used their full inventories.
Maximum characters examined for language detection
The selected detector is unavailable; trying an alternative.
Type or paste the text to translate. Translation starts after you stop typing; the arrow button requests a fresh translation immediately.
Move down to check this rule later
Move up to check this rule earlier
Gray mode: only local translation engines are used. The online engine is not called and no internet check is awaited. Click to enable online translation.

Green: online translation enabled. Amber: translating or retrying. Red: translation failed. All eligible engines start immediately; a better result cancels lower-priority work. Click to switch to gray mode.
The translation appears here. You can edit this text too; your changes are translated back into the other box.
A preset applies waiting and retry settings together. You can also adjust individual values and save them under your own profile name.
Drag the bottom-right corner to resize the window.
If nothing matches, the simple-mode language pair is used.
Add the first condition to choose which language translates to which.
Rules are checked from top to bottom. The first match is used; languages in the same block are joined by OR.
The left text box’s language. Automatic detects the text’s language; when two-way automatic selection is enabled, routing rules choose the other language too.
Drag to change the text boxes’ width ratio. The ratio is preserved when the window is resized; settings can reset it to 50 percent.
The right text box’s language. Editing this text starts translation in the reverse direction. Both selectors can be Automatic when two-way automatic selection is enabled.
